task.goal: An order service inserts a row and an outbox event that a separate publisher later sends. create_order currently commits the order before inserting its event, so an event failure leaves an order with no notification. Fix create_order(db, order_id, amount) and pending_events(db) in outbox.py. Order and event must commit atomically; duplicate order IDs must leave no extra event; pending events must be ordered by insertion and carry the exact JSON payload; reject nonpositive amounts. Run visible tests and validate.
